transcript.content: Hello, welcome. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess... I'm just having some trouble at work. I can't really keep my mind on a task long enough to finish it anymore. Even when it's important. Like, I'll start tracing a client's network problem, and... ten minutes later, I realize I've reread the same log entries three times. And I still don't know what they say. So... that's why I'm here.
Do you often feel restless, on edge, or anxious while trying to focus on tasks, or does the difficulty concentrating happen even when you're not feeling stressed?

I don't know if it's stress. It's... well, even when I'm just supposed to sit still and listen, I get this feeling. Like there's a motor humming under my skin. 

I just... I feel like I need to stand up, or check something, or just move to the next problem right that second. So... yeah, I guess I get restless.
Do you experience this same restlessness and trouble focusing in situations outside of work, like at home or in social settings?
I suppose so. Yeah, it happens at home, too. I don't really go out much, so... I don't know about social things. But at home, sure.
Do you often feel like you need to be doing something all the time, or find it hard to slow down even when you want to?

I suppose... yeah. Like on my days off, I tell myself I'll just rest. But... I don't really do that. 

I end up just bouncing around. I'll start a laptop repair, then wander off to look at the garage shelves... then I'm checking a chess email, or reorganizing some cables. Just... moving from thing to thing. And by night, nothing is actually fully done. 

So... I guess I do find it hard to slow down.
When did you first notice these feelings of restlessness and trouble focusing? Were they something you experienced even as a child, or did they start more recently in your life?

I don't know... it's been a long time. I guess it's always been there. 

My mother... she still brings it up sometimes. Jokes about my old grade school report cards. She says the teachers always wrote that I was bright, but... I wouldn't stay in my seat. And I guess I blurted out answers a lot. 

I'd even lose my homework after I'd already finished it. So... yeah, I suppose it's not a new thing.
Do you often find yourself acting without thinking, like interrupting others, making impulsive decisions, or feeling like you can't wait your turn?

I suppose... yeah. Mostly at work. When people are trying to explain a tech problem to me... I tend to cut them off. 

I know I shouldn't, but... the answer just jumps into my head. So I end up talking over them. Or sometimes I just... reach over and grab their keyboard before they're even done explaining the issue. I don't really mean to, but... yeah. I do that.
